newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes weaker in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes weaker in tight range.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished a tad lower against the U.S. dollar on Monday, after meandering in a tight range.
The rate ended at T$27.483, versus T$27.480 at Thursday's close. The turnover was a hefty US$296.5 million. Friday and Saturday were domestic holidays.
"The Taiwan dollar took cues from other currencies," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The U.S. dollar surged against major currencies over the three-day holiday, putting the Taiwan unit under pressure on the open, he noted.
But demand for the U.S. dollar was soft.
"Exports are weak, but imports are even weaker," the dealer said. "We didn't see big dollar orders."
Another dealer attributed the tight range to the reluctance to trade because banks are closing books for the quarter.
